item.title: Meduza: By Putin’s own estimate, Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries have cost Russia 1% of GDP. But he says stopping them isn’t worth halting attacks on Ukrainian vessels.
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin rejected the idea of halting attacks on Ukrainian ships in exchange for Ukraine ending its strikes on Russian oil refineries. He made the remarks at the Valdai Forum.

item.title: Meduza: Latvia bans its public broadcaster from producing regular Russian-language content (except during emergencies)
item.description: Latvia’s parliament, the Saeima, has passed a law that effectively bans the public broadcaster LSM from producing content in Russian.

item.title: Meduza: Explosions at chemical plant in Moscow region reportedly kill seven, force evacuation of more than 40 people
item.description: Russian Telegram channels with ties to the security services reported explosions in a production unit at a chemical plant in the Moscow region town of Krasnozavodsk.
